notes: Authoritative source: Crestron's official product page and the 4-Series Control Systems technical reference manual (docs.crestron.com), both consistent. The MC4-R is PoE-powered (IEEE 802.3at Type 1 / 802.3af-compatible PD) via its RJ45 LAN port — there is no separate AC/DC power input connector on the unit. Several ports use 3.5mm detachable terminal blocks (Cresnet, RS-232 COM, Versiport, Relay, IR outputs); mapped to the closest available connector ids (euroblock for generic terminal blocks; ir for the dedicated IR-output terminal blocks; rs232 semantically describes the COM port's signal though its physical connector is also a 3-pin terminal block). Two ports could not be mapped to any id in the allowed connector list and are omitted from the ports array: (1) a microSD card slot (accepts up to 32GB, 4GB card included, for log storage) and (2) the infiNET EX RF antenna connector (2.4GHz ISM, IEEE 802.15.4). Ethernet is 100BASE-T/1000BASE-TX (graded eth-1g, the higher of the two supported speeds). USB is explicitly USB 2.0. This is a desktop/rack-convertible unit — it ships with rack ears and is 1RU rack-mountable but can also be freestanding or surface-mounted; rackUnits set to 1 since rack mounting is a supported explicit spec. A related model, MC4-R-I, exists with similar but not identical I/O — not covered here.

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: 100BASE-T/1000BASE-TX Ethernet; also serves as PoE (IEEE 802.3at Type 1 / 802.3af-compatible, Class 0, 12.95W) powered-device input — no separate power connector on this unit

ports.name: CRESNET
ports.note: 4-pin 3.5mm detachable terminal block; Cresnet server port, provides up to 2.5W to Cresnet devices

ports.name: COM
ports.note: 3-pin 3.5mm detachable terminal block; bidirectional RS-232, up to 115.2k baud

ports.name: VERSIPORT
ports.note: 3-pin 3.5mm detachable terminal block; 2 digital I/O or analog input ports (0-24VDC digital / 0-10VDC analog)

ports.name: RELAY
ports.note: 4-pin 3.5mm detachable terminal block; 2 normally-open isolated relays, 1A 30VAC/VDC

ports.name: IR 1-4
ports.note: Two 4-pin 3.5mm detachable terminal blocks comprising 4 IR output ports, up to 1.2MHz; 4 IRP2 emitters included

ports.name: IR IN
ports.note: 3.5mm TRS mini-phone jack for connecting a CNXRMIRD IR receiver (RC-5 commands)

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-A host port for external storage (up to 1TB)
